text: Very pleasing graphics and easy to play. A nice twist on the classic monopoly board game. But some really annoying aspects are; not being able to add players as friends (can only add from Facebook), extremely intrusive pop-ups pushing in game purchases constantly, and it looks like people have worked out cheating as I regularly see players on leaderboards with absurd scores.

Good game to pass a bit of time. I enjoy playing it with my partner. A couple of things that prevent me from giving 5 stars. The micro transaction prices are way too high for what you get. Also, the trading system for stickers needs some serious refinement, the FB group method is just a haven for scammers. Take a leaf out of Supercell's book and how the card trade token system works on there. It works great. I'll be continuing to play this as a fun game, I look forward to future updates.

It's a game that's not wanting to be played. There is a constant struggle to be able to play it, if you get 3 minutes play a day, count yourself lucky. They encourage you to play with friends, and you need friends to get more playtime by finishing tasks together, and if you still can't, you need to log into fb group to 'trade', which basically is full of people cheating you. So you fight to play, and then get left outside, rely on friends and then get messed around. Yeah, super fun.

This game is enjoyable, but the persistent prompts to make in-app purchases detract from the experience, which is why I'm rating it two stars. The issues include: 1. Exhausted your rolls? Expect three pop-ups urging you to buy more. 2. As soon as you open the app, you'll be bombarded with pop-ups soliciting purchases. 3. Running low on in-game currency for upgrades? Brace yourself for a slew of pop-ups.

The developers of the game have only one aim - to generate revenue. You will find that this game is getting less fun since its introduction, and becoming almost meaningless because the only way to progress and have fun is if you have lots of rolls. But the developers want you to spend money to buy rolls. Other aspects of the game is also tweaked in the developer's favour. You will find little joy in playing this game. Don't bother starting. I haven't even mention the many glitches.

It's great, but seems the game now wants you to spend alot of money, dices are far and few in between, making it impossible to finish mini games or even come close to finishing, without spending a ton of cash. Also, Peg-E is rigged to fall to the bottom left! Let alone trying to finish stickers, you almost never get a new sticker, so it's impossible to finish albums.

It's an alright game, a bit like board kings. One thing I have noticed and is becoming increasingly more annoying is having more and more offers and deals pushed at you each time you run out of rolls. It was 2, and now it's up to 5 different offers that pop up. If I don't want to spend money on it, stop forcing it on people. I'll spend If I want to. Thanks.

The game is fun and addicting. The reason I rate it so low, the cost to really get involved in the game is just too much. When you begin the game, there are first time purchases that are somewhat worth while. Why not reset these once a month or even week. You would get a lot more purchases. It's unfortunate, but $70 for less than 2000 dice? That amount of dice just doesn't last long enough to warrant the cost. Some if us are willing to invest, but the pay off has to be worth it.

Monopoly GO feels like a money grab game. I've spent a significant amount buying 🎲, hoping to unlock new items and progress faster, but all I keep getting are duplicate stickers. It’s frustrating because, despite putting in money, it feels like the rewards are limited and repetitive. If you're someone who has a lot of patience and extra money to spare, you might find some enjoyment in it, but for me, it's becoming a bit of a letdown.

This isn't Monopoly, just so you know. It doesn't even remotely resemble the commonly known Monopoly game we know. This is an "idle clicker game", where the player just touches the screen occasionally to roll some dies to move their coin and get money to build some buildings, (which is also just a selection of buildings already listed). This seems to be the entire premise of the game. It is boring beyond imagination and is clearly targeted at children.

I really did love this game, was constantly making sure I was going on multiple times a day, and spent lots of $$. However, it is almost impossible to complete an album without putting in cash, it has taken all the fun out of it. Been playing about 1.5 years, have only received the purple pack in the community chest maybe 3 times. Don't care anymore about completing tasks, will probably uninstall.

This game used to be fun, but I'm done. It's unending and repetitive with no real objective, yet it's highly addictive. Rolls are hard to come by and you can probably never finish albums without spending money. When you get close to completing, you don't get the golden cards needed to finish. A time I used over 4000 rolls and still didn't win an event. When you roll a no. sometimes it moves a space too much or one less. I wasted so much time with this cheating, rigged app, I am uninstalling.

This game takes very long to give you dice when your dice is finished. You have to wait 10 minutes to get 10 dices. Also, the stickers keep on repeating itself over and over, and you can't finish a set very quickly. Also, when you are finished with one level and you move on to a next level, you only get 50 dices. I think that it should be increased. Please fix these problems.
man words can't even explain how much I love this game! I love Monopoly Go more then you know

It's definitely not fun anymore. it's like having a 2nd job. The fun has been sucked right out of the game. If you're looking for a game that forces you to spend money (20 if you just started-$150 when you level up) to ease the anxiety from losing then this if for you. . Every time you log in countless pop ups asking you to spend. Ugh. If you want to win or complete events, forget it. My advice, Run.

I like the game and enjoy playing. there are no video ads, but because of this, you are very limited to 7 dice rolls an hour. more if you get them through gameplay. you can choose to pay for more, but this is quite expensive, allowing for small amounts of extra gameplay. without the limitations, I would enjoy the game more. I know that video ads can be boring and can interrupt gameplay on other apps, but in this one, there is a complete pause on gameplay if you're not willing to pay to play.

This game just keeps getting more ridiculous. I've never seen another game that doesn't give you the opportunity to move ahead, unless you buy stuff. I guess that's the entire point of this game.... anyhow, things like you need to land on certain squares to get rewards but you certainly don't when you need. When you don't need to, you land on them constantly. Absolutely horrendous how fixed this game is to set you up to spend money on it.

Very expensive, for a game. Very little opportunities to get free rolls that are worth anything and then special maps which also cost with amount of spins available. Waiting far too long on construction of properties. Irl you just take a house or hotel from banker and bonk it on space. Takes no time at all. Then you have to build up each property. For a game oriantated towards children very easy to spend money.

This game is not a game, it's a slot machine simulator. You don't manage properties and there's no actual skill involved. The only input you have is choosing your multiplier and you can put the game on auto mode where it will keep rolling for you with the same multiplier (again like a slot machine). This game shouldn't be given to children it's designed to form a gambling addiction. I played a few hours then realised that there's hundreds, possibly thousands of hours worth "gameplay"

Rather dissapointing. You expect when you download an app to enjoy the game, but it seems like that's out of fashion. This is just a coin master and monopoly mix. Yeah, if you like mindlessly clicking and spamming buttons you're set, but if you're after a good game, this isn't it. Just another cash grab pushed as a game that it isn't. Do better, it's possible to find a way better game than this.

Gets boring fast. Initially, you receive 5 rolls every hour, and after playing for several days, this, for me, increased to 7 rolls per hour. Occasionally, a multiplier of up to 20x is offered, but it's only valid for an hour. So, with just 7 rolls per hour, it's practically impossible to utilize a 20x multiplier. It would enhance the experience if more rolls were available at shorter intervals as I find myself going through the motions of rolling the few dice available, then closing the game.

Started off very well, then introduction of the baking to the game caused issues such as 30% loading or kicking you out the game spontaneously. I just noticed an update and thought maybe this is a bug fix downloaded it, and the tax rebate that had a day left has now been removed and been 40 from obtaining the large amount of dice, it's very disappointing. Plus, to add to this, some players are still able to play and wipe any money you have. Maybe this is not a bug, and the game has been hacked!

Very addictive game. Massive downside is that all the cards you collect disappear after 30 days. So you have to collect them all over again, its hard enough getting all the cards as it is!!! The trading Facebook group is a waste of time, ok I've got some cards but not many from it. Problem is there is a set of 15 or so cards everyone is after, they are very rare so you lose all you have before getting the 162. Uninstalled as about to lose them all. Alot in other groups feel the same way.

It seems I've got to the point that playing any further is useless. The higher you go, the more unachievable everything is. Instead of rewarding the people who enjoy playing the game, they make it less possible to continue without paying. You never get new stickers. The builds are over priced, rolls non-existent. Just not fun anymore. Thankfully, there are tons of similar games out there, and I have moved on from this one.

Fun. But it's very repeatable, So It gets boring after a while great work to the developers! But I'm just bored with already. Just going around and around. And pretty much the same thing over and over again. So sorry but it's not for Me. Also the regeneration of the Dice Is Very!! slow and you don't get very many rolls unless you spend real money. And that's not happening! So bye have fun spending your money on Monopoly board game!! Which I have Also if I wanted to play. Lol.

It was fun. I'd accumulated so much dice money etc. I was over level 1000 but today it glitched. I couldn't do anything couldn't access anything. So I uninstalled hoping to fix it. No you do that you go back to the start. Everything you gained you lose. That was the hardest blow of all. I've played heaps of games but not one that doesn't remember you account.

I am done with this game. It was enjoyable and fun at one point but that was before their improvements and changes. It has become a money grab where one needs to buy rolls in order to get anywhere in it. It never used to be like that. I am lvl 10,856 and finding it very difficult to just complete some of the daily goals now without having to buy rolls. I have been unable to complete daily "upgrade landmarks" goals on the 10 rolls per hour that I get and miss out on in-game rewards. Not fun

Decided to come back to this game. whilst it is fun, performance on a Pixel 6 Pro 12GB RAM isn't the best. Moreover, the game is riddled with popup microtransactions. It gets pretty annoying when you finish with rolls and a popup saying "buy more" appears. Some mornings I just want to get the rolls done, but have to spend a few minutes clicking "no" on all the popup "buy this". I hate that design philosophy. This also goes for the mini events...

When you break it down, it's just pressing 'roll' - the game plays itself. More so when you choose 'auto-roll'! Might as well put your feet up. What's the point? You accumulate money, can't seem to choose what to buy, build pointless structures and try to do others in. The train station 'games' are easy and the same every time. There's no fun, challenge or education here. Add in the ridiculous pay-for-content stuff and you've got a dreadful so-called game. Deleted within the hour.

The game is very fun but it takes too long to receive the dice. Not only that, it keeps giving you more and more extra stickers, even if you exchange them, it gives back the same sticker. Can you pls upgrade this game to make it more fun and not to annoy people? What's the point giving the same extra sticker card but cannot be used? Why not create a group in the game where people can trade with each other, as opposed to needing to join a Facebook group to trade? Gonna uninstall soon!!! BYEEEE 🙃

I thought this was going to be at least slightly close to the original Monopoly experience, but after playing, this is just coinmaster with a monopoly skin on it, the gameplay gets repetitive and boring really quickly and they are aware of it as they are very generous when you start playing to get you to pay for more rolls as you'll want more in that moment. Also, why force to use a Facebook account to save progress when a lot more options are available? (such as Google account or Play games)

Hello [insert name]! Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us. We are doing our best to keep kosher a good profitable experience so that everything inside the game can be increasingly seductive enough to buy, no matter if you are a paying player or not. Of course, we hear you (but the dev team doesn't), and we will be looking for opportunities to improve our game further to increase profitable engagement at the expense of gameplay.

I downloaded this game in 10/23... deleteed it and I was pretty high on the ladder also. I just reinstalled it again a couple of days ago. This game is fun with or without real friends. This game is fun and way better than the real game you wanted to flip over. 💕

I absolutely love this game and have been playing it everyday for almost a year. Unfortunately today after the new update it does not want to open anymore. I have un-installed and installed the game again. My Internet connection is also good but it still does not want to work. The same speech bubble pops up saying: "We're sorry, an error occurred requiring the game to restart." and it just restarts over and over again. So disappointed 😞

This game used to be very fun when I first played, but recently greed has got the best of them. Less stickers in sticker packs, events becoming harder with new impossible designs in the peg-e for example. The further you go up in the levels, the harder the game gets with far less dice. In order to actually get anywhere with this game, you would have to spend ridiculous amounts of money to get any sort of reward. Its really a shame as I enjoyed this game far more when I first started playing.

Errors occur during pivotal moments of game play and customer service does nothing about it even when I provide a screen recording of the issue. Edit Nov. 24,2024. The game doesn't offer all players the same options. I was only a few digs away from finishing the dig event, which would have given me the last sticker I needed to finish my entire album. I used up all my dice for the event in addition to spending money to buy more dice. Couldnt finish the event. Worst game ever. Don't play it.

I'm forced to comment here because the developers and technicians ignore my complaint on the app and via the website. I spent so much money on this game, so I'm very disappointed. When I completed the album the first round, all sets still showed as "completed" even though there were clearly no stickers in the sets. There are big tournaments happening, so I'm playing as usual, and I'm getting stickers. I completed two sets again, but no rewards. I feel demotivated from trading, even.

The was great. I loved the game! Trading stickers was a nightmare with all the scammers trying to sell you the stuff. DO NOT CLICK ON ANY OF THOSE LINKS. My phone got hacked and taken over control where the scammers kept adding themselves to my friend's list and posting stuff without my consent. It got so bad, to the point that I couldn't even log in to my Facebook, without having to change my password upteen times! I had enough. I had to delete the game.

It's fun, but it's almost impossible now to complete events or albums as a f2p player. When I first started playing, yeah, it was tough to do these things, but it was still achievable. Takes the fun right out of it. Maybe dial back the difficulty and let us get gold cards more often again. Or maybe even make gold card trading more often. Idk, man. But I'm done after this album. Thanks for the memories.

It seems the longer you have played the game, the more disadvantaged you are with completing anything. Collecting stickers, completing sets, completing albums, daily challenges and mini games, etc. You don't have to spend money to play. However, if you want to complete anything, it's the only way to achieve it.

Everything feels so preset. I spent over 1,000 dice and couldn’t even land on a single event icon. For the current event, I’ve not once managed to trigger the Mega Bonus. Honestly, it’s frustrating. No wonder fewer and fewer people want to play. Dice are never enough, and when you move to another map, the same dice pool applies. Plus, the dice limit is so low. If this keeps up, the game is going to crash sooner or later.

Monopoly GO is a fast-paced mobile twist on the classic board game. Its colorful visuals, mini-events, and daily rewards make it addictive and easy to enjoy in short bursts. However, the heavy reliance on in-app purchases and limited free rolls can frustrate players over time. Great for casual fun, but not for those seeking the full Monopoly strategy experience. Overall, it’s a polished yet pay-heavy game.

Changing my review to 2 stars. I ultimately decided to delete the game. With each new round of special events/updates, the algorithm is made increasingly difficult and unlikely for the average player to complete. I felt the fun was taken out of it that way. I don't have to time to play on multiple devices and seeing as I only played with one account, I couldn't get myself the needed stickers or win any events.

Clearly designed to catch people out and give money to Scopely. Far too many extra things when loading back into a game: multiple things trying to get you to buy bonus packs EVERY SINGLE TIME. And the cross moves to catch you out, sometimes at the bottom sometimes in the corner, and the next one has a price tag where you've just clicked, so be careful! Daily bonuses do a similar scummy thing. In game, whenever something happens, it takes ages, and the roll multiplier makes no sense.

Terrible game glitches constantly, never enought dice either just wants you to purchase more. Game has became that bad and so many are leaving its hard to even trade your cards online. This partner event was the last straw, 2 partners of mine finished before me and I did not get the reward!!!! In each one which was to be built, I was short 20,000 points!! That's a lot of drums and dice. Messaged customer support, and I got a generic compensation,and then they gave dice ,hich still did not cover

A Cash Grab & Unfair To Regular Players. When you first start the game, you get a lot of rewards for levelling up and completing boards, but they never improve. I was around 7000 "net value" and hadn't received dice as a reward for levelling up in so long. Or even stickers. The board completion will always only give a standard 50 dice no matter how expensive the buildings become. Also, Scopely made the events and sticker album harder to complete this round with fewer rewards. Uninstalled.

It's fun, but they try and make you buy dice to play as getting dice isn't easy. You get a million gold doubles that you can't trade. The higher the level you're on, the harder it is to achieve daily goals. I've noticed that some of your moves don't add up to what the dice rolled. Any issue you have and bring to customer support, they don't care. It takes them forever to get back to you if they do at all. Really, there's a lot of negatives about this game.

Monopoly Go, is hardly a game. It requires no thoughs, decisions or skill, you just auto roll till your dice are depleted and that's about it. You never do something fulfilling apart from simply waiting to get lucky. It claims that "Monopoly go is more fun with friends" and yet you can't really interact with them in any significant way. Overall this is your average mobile "game" that is more interested in getting your money through atrocious 'deals' than providing a meaningful experience

In the beginning the game was fun, but after you get up in the levels it's starts to become boring. As there is nothing new added to the game for moving up the levels bar from what the map looks like. Also it is to hard to collect stickers and the mini games they put on in the weekend are fun, until they start putting on the same games on a rotation. Could there be more benefits for moving up the levels? and make it less expensive? Also it's annoying you need wifi and need to wait for dices.

Updates made it rubbish. Game was bad enough before trying to get you tu buy things constantly with annoying pop ups everytime you loaded the game or ran out of dice. Even worse now, the game is fully rigged to make you buy stuff, always landing on corners, until the event needs you to land on corners for points and then you rarely do, landing on train stations FAR less frequently. And this car event.. impossible to get nearly enough points to complete even one car! It's a scam.

This is not a game. There is no strategy or game play. It's simply rolling dice and going round the board to collect money to upgrade to be able to access the next level where it's the same thing. All while being bombarded with in app purchase requests. There is no trading no end point. You can literally set it to auto roll and if they allow the collect function to be auto there would be absolutely nothing for the user to do.

Could be a great game. It's fun. It was fun to begin with, but now they changed the goal posts. Made everything impossible so that you have to spend money to progress. I'd rather watch ads and get more dice for it. The rewards are minimal. Bring ads for those who can't or dont want to pay to play. Docking another star from 3 to 2 because I've noticed a few more negatives: Always land on corners when there's no event. Then when you get rewards for landing on corners I never land on them. Rigged

I really liked this game but now feel it is pointless playing. There have been so many glitches lately, and you just get a generic apology after and little compensation. Impossible to get the cards you need towards the end, when I did it glitches and I lost them with no getting them back. Unless your willing to put serious money into the game its pointless and even then not guaranteed what you need. I'm disappointed because it had the potential to be a great game.

I like the game so far, but I recently purchased dices because they have the first time offer, I got the incorrect contents, something else instead. I reached out to support they responded that I need to provide more information, and I did. Now I have been waiting for 2 days and nothing, I am not sure why support is taking so long. I don't even know how long I ll have to wait before my issue is rectified and it's so frustrating. I don't even know how to reach out to expedite this 😔

Never get enough dice. Can never finish the events. I finally got really close to finishing the car event. So close I actually spent money to get more rolls and a sticker pack to give me the best chance. Out of six hundred rolls I landed on the wheels twice. Did not land on any travel spaces. I actually feel the game hindered me so I couldn't finish the last car. I've learned a valuable lesson I won't be paying for thing any more.

This game is great and fun, however, and I don't know why I stopped receiving reward points when I reached level 126, as the rules showed in the affiliate apps. Once I reach level 126, I will receive 4,500,000 points. It's upsetting because I invested a time just to get a little extra in my pocket. But until now, I have not received anything.

This game is getting worse. Now theres a limit on how many times you can "log in" to the game. I play on an apple product, and every 30 minutes or so if im not playing, it automatically logs you out, and after so many log ins, it will lock you completely out of the game for 24 hours. Not to mention when your in a horrible service area and you get kicked from the game and have to log back in again, well back to having warnings and your account locked within the game. BEWARE EVERYONE!

I love this game. I do find it ridiculous the struggle for stickers. Constantly sending packs with the stickers repeatedly. There are not enough chances to send stickers to other folks. And it honestly is taking away the fun, and that says a lot" as iplay every day. Stickers shouldn't be so difficult to find and so hard to trade.. It's a great and fun game. But it needs to be a bit better, or ppl will get discouraged and stop playing. Will update my review if anything changes

The new updates made the game unbearable to play. The incentives became less and less the further you go along, and it's just simply much harder to progress and have genuine fun with it. Now it's just a cash grab, especially that you heavily nerfed ways for free to play players to get dice, and for what? New album is just straight up a pain to complete. After this i'm dropping this game completely

Very polished game. Looks really nice and plays pretty great for the first hour. Constantly bombarding you with things to do, more dice rolls, more money, lots of level ups. Soon however you reach a point where you can do nothing but wait or pay. Leave for a while and come back later for more play time.

Trying too hard for money, I mean you will be fine the first day and then you can play 10 to 15 minutes before you run out of dice and expected to pay for more. Also a hard push to add friends to unlock more. Then yheres the game, its missing the best bits of monopoly it's nothing like the game and none of the good bits from the game are in it, intact it's nothing like monopoly. Save your time there's better stuff out there

Game sucks, my Facebook was hacked and banned so I couldn't connect to Facebook to save my progress, I had to play as guest, went far until board 8 or 9 I think, then I got a bug where it couldn't find a network, uninstalled and installed again hoping that the progress is saved, well it didn't. It would be nice if the game has multiple options to save progress instead of just facebook. In conclusion, this game sucks

This game is not really a game cause everything is automated and decided by the app since you have absolutely no input to determine the outcome of anything and the constant popup requests to spend money are insufferable. It is first in board games only because it is featured in many "pay to play" apps. The graphics are very nice, but that's not enough to save the game. Pointless. N.b. I want to thank the developers for the reply, but I never said nor implied the game was unfair.

it is fun and I love it. When you run out of dice you just have to wait and they give you within a 1 hour period or so. Try it you'll get hooked for sure. The option to hold or touch Go each time is optional, so you play or the game rolls the dice automatically for you but it does go faster that way. When building you get money to build more as you smash other peoples property down and even if they use a shield you still get a bit of points. I really like this game, thanks.

The game is flooded with paid bundles, but I guess that's standard for most mobile games. It would definitely be more enjoyable (and less annoying) if I didn't have to close 3/4 popups every time I run out of dice. A "don't show again" option would be much appreciated, since it starts to wear you out after a while.

I loved this game when I first started playing, but it just keeps getting worse and worse. Rolls are rigged, it's hard to get anything, the sticker albums are harder and harder to complete... And the last partner event just made it literally impossible to complete without buying something. I had contemplated spending money on the game, but I absolutely never will now. Scopely, do better by your players!!

Not enough servers or the devs can't keep up with the popularity of this game. My game keeps crashing to the point that it's unplayable and the progress before the crash doesn't save. Because of their bad servers, it likely avoided the tiles because I rolled at least 25 times (with bonus of x10) with a 700 of available rolls and never landed on the railroad slot. Tldr; the game is no longer playable because the devs can't keep up with the popularity and lack of servers

It's very mundane after a while and so heavy on pushing you to pay for extra bits. Forst mi ute of the game is closing the pop-ups that appear, and then all you do is roll dice. There are so many bugs, too! Biggest one is when you get down to a number of dice below the multiplication factor, 3 pop-ups appear asking if you want to buy more dice!

After months of playing, I’ve never completed a full sticker album on my own. I play solo, and my friends don’t have the time to help. I’m also not comfortable trading with strangers who might not play fair. As a dedicated solo Monopoly Go player, completing a sticker album would mean so much. On top of that, before reaching the main board, I have to close 4–5 pop-ups asking me to buy things, which is frustrating. I'm a loyal solo player that is slowly losing motivation to continue supporting.

Enjoyable game at first but once you reach the higher levels it's more difficult to get more dice nor cash. Its very boring nowadays. They wont let you stay in the game because the game is good only for beginners. The algorithm sucks! They know if you have plenty of cash or dice so they wont give you that luck for more dice or cash. Stickers are now hard to get. They want you to spend your money so they can gain. Money matters only in this game. No wonder coz it's a monopoly game 😂😂😂

I left a good review on the beginning!!!?? I was playing the game for a long time even spend so much money on it and now for some reason I update the version any took me back to the beginning That's absolutely unforgivable I am not really happy at all. Is no cos of the game ( how much time did I spend, and my money, at the same time) I was at level 800/M I had very good friends. I lost everything. Even in my spare time at work on my break time I was playing 😞😞😞. Something needs to be done.🤨

My app won't open. It loads to around 50% and then I get an error notification telling me to restart due to issues, even after trying that more than 20 times. I've done and checked all the things suggested to me by the helpline multiple times, and my Google Play account won't open. My app doesn't show the Christmas update either, I am concerned as my progress is past 4000 and I can't be sure I'd be interested in the game if I had to start over. I need this fixed ASAP. I'm HIGHLY disappointed.

To start I must say at first it was a nice game, keeps you hooked. But it takes 1 hour to get just 8 dice, that sucks. And with the mini missions it's hard to complete because you just don't get enough dice. And when you complete a card set it helps but if again you run out of dice and have to wait so long to just get eight dice. This is why I will delete this game at the end of the day it's just waist of time.

Edit: Still absolutely rigged. Especially around events. The game is rigged. It's not random chance dice rolls. First season was fun, was easy to get stickers, and didn't rely on paying for a functioning game. Second season the drop rate is much lower, spins in partner events and hotels lands you on the lowest possible scores, when you're rolling dice it always 'mysteriously' rolls in a way that you don't get what you need. Wouldn't recommend. Will be uninstall the game soon.

Considering to uninstall it by the end of the album event, if still getting the same gold card. Like other said, at first it was really fun to play but once you got only one card left which is gold card, everything escalated. I got bored by keep getting the same duplicate gold card, small amount of dice which requires a lot of time. Anyway, thank you for the early fun experience

My game is forever glitched, if I hit random when having to attack someone's board I guarantee if anything is destroyed it shows as if I've done it. You can only get so far without having to pay to play due to stickers. I have yet to see someone complete it without spending a single penny on the game, haven't got anything new in weeks and probably won't till the new stickers are released. Pretty fixed honestly.

Complete money grab. If you look at how much money was made by Scopely in their first year, you'll understand why they have squeezed all the fun out of this game. After you complete each level, you are given 50 dice, this should be increased as you progress as 50 dice is nothing. Also, the cost to complete your buildings as you progress is ridiculous. Trillions are needed which gets near impossible to save without people robbing you. Gold cards need the ability to swap more frequently 🤬🤬🤬🤬

We get new albums for stickers, when are we going to get some different boards? We are building tje same board, just paying different amounts. I do have to agree with other players, it's becoming more a money invested game tom compete for the better prizes, especially with the events. I for one have spent far too much on this game that I'd like to admit. Not anymore.

The game itself is okay, decent way to pass the time. Annoying how often I get a popup pushing in app purchases, I don't think apps should be so aggressive with trying to get people to purchase things. It was fun at first, but once you reach higher net worth (I'm at 13k), the game makes it close to impossible to progress since the earnings and expenses are not balanced. The algorithm is always against you. Unless it's just me! Every time you feel like you're on a good running spree (example: loads of dice to roll) it will non-stop, constantly give you the worse possible outcome there is in the game until you're back down to a normal amount of dice and then it will give you some OKAY outcomes to keep you hooked. This game had so much potential to be amazing. So many pop ups. Everything is so expensive. The stickers are impossible to get. The greed of this game is atrocious. This is a great game and it can get addictive sometimes. But you need to deal with players that just constantly attack your board with no punishment. Absolutely awful at the moment , so many glitches . I've spent a fortune playing this game and honestly it's been a waste as it's glitches so much . If you say you're under 18 at the very beginning, there're no downsides though.

Leveling up is useless. There is no sense of accomplishment while playing. Mechanics are simple, roll dice, attack other boards, make money, upgrade your board, move on to the next board. Also there are so many in game ads asking me to spend money on rolls or to gain more in game cash. I counted 4 or 5 when simply opening the app, among other ones that randomly pop up while playing.
